---
title: "Pundits Putting Their Money Where Their Mouth Is"
date: "2005-08-23"
categories: ["Economics"]
---

Two pundits prepared to put down some serious green on the five year outlook for oil prices, with [John Tierney](http://www.nytimes.com/2005/08/23/opinion/23tierney.html "John Tierney") following the advice of the late Julian Simon:

*if you find anyone willing to bet that natural resource prices are going up, take him for all you can.*
